description: This file defines and exports plugin SDK facades, including functions to generate facade modules and types for various plugin paths. It imports dependencies such as 'fs', 'path', and 'typescript' to handle file system operations, path resolution, and TypeScript AST parsing. The code supports dynamic module resolution, export collection, and code generation for plugin facades, aimed at facilitating plugin extension management within a project.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript/TypeScript module string for a given plugin facade entry, handling source imports, exports, lazy loading, and type definitions based on the provided runtime context and source export kinds.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Creates a TypeScript interface for mapping plugin SDK facade subpaths to their module types and associated source modules and types, facilitating type safety and import consistency.

methods.name: listFacadeEntrySourcePaths
methods.description: Returns a set of unique source paths related to a facade entry, including primary source and additional exports.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceExportKinds
methods.description: Uses TypeScript compiler API to analyze a source file and determine the kinds of exports it contains, such as whether they are types, values, functions, arrays, or primitives.

methods.name: resolveFacadeSourceTypescriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the file path to a TypeScript source (.ts or .tsx) underlying a JavaScript source for a given plugin facade, considering project structure.

methods.name: resolveFacadeModuleResolutionContext
methods.description: Creates and caches a TypeScript compiler context for module resolution, potentially reading tsconfig.json configurations.

methods.name: collectRuntimeApiPreExports
methods.description: Reads a specified runtime API file, parses its export declarations, and collects the list of exported symbols, excluding type-only exports.

methods.name: normalizeFacadeSourceParts
methods.description: Parses a source path to extract directory name and artifact basename, supporting internal source resolution schemes.
